RenderChartRequeryRequest.description:
Request for ``render_chart_requery`` — the app-visible re-query tool the
chart-viewer widget calls for drill-down, brush-to-zoom, and filtering.

This tool is intended to be invoked by the widget (``_meta.ui.visibility =
["app"]``), not the model. It translates high-level interactions into an
``extra_form_data`` override and re-runs the same authorized data query.

cache_timeout.description: Cache timeout override in seconds (0 to disable)

filter.description: Drill filter as an object, e.g. {"col": "country", "val": "US"}. Alternative to filter_col/filter_val; takes precedence when both are provided. Sent by the chart-viewer widget on click-to-drill.

filter_col.description: Column to filter on (paired with filter_val) when drilling into a clicked data point.

filter_val.description: Value the clicked data point represents; filters filter_col == filter_val.

force_refresh.description: Invalidate cache and fetch fresh data

granularity.description: Time grain override for the narrowed range (e.g. P1D, PT1H) when zooming into a time-series. This is a best-effort hint: saved query contexts for some chart configurations ignore time_grain_sqla.

identifier.description: Chart identifier (numeric ID or UUID) to re-query.

limit.description: Maximum number of data rows to return.

time_range.description: Time range override (Superset time-range syntax, e.g. "Last quarter" or an ISO "start : end" range) for brush-to-zoom.
